Image 3 is THE OUTFIT: take exactly this long black cocoon coat with the wide wrapped collar, black wide trousers pooling on the floor and black pointed boots. The output is one single photograph, portrait 4:5.

Shot: Camera at waist height, 50mm lens, f/8, straight on. Only her body from the chest to the hip, her bent arm and hand are in frame, in exactly the outfit from the reference. Her face is never visible: she is turned away or cropped by the frame, and no face, cheek, chin or profile shows.

Place: A city street at midday: pale weathered stone walls, smooth pavement, deep doorways; nothing else unless the shot names it.

Light: Hard, direct midday sun from high on one side: crisp black shadows with sharp edges, long shadows on the pavement, bright stone, no fill.

It is a real photograph made in camera by a campaign photographer, not a render and not a digital filter. Only the objects named in the shot are on set. The design surface is new and clean, crisp at its edges and corners, without blowing out.
